mengenai.title: ABOUT US
mengenai.p1: Yayasan Infaq Malaysia (YIM) was established as an NGO dedicated to uplifting the asnaf community in Malaysia and internationally.
mengenai.p2: YIM is a fresh and relevant platform to coordinate and assist those in the asnaf community who are in need.
mengenai.p3: We are committed to being a pioneer in the education sector, bringing world-class expertise to students in Malaysia, in line with the Ministry of Education's vision: "Quality Education, Educated People, Prosperous Nation".

visiMisi.title: VISION, MISSION & OBJECTIVES
visiMisi.visiText: To become a leading coordinator of education and welfare as an NGO for Malaysia and the world.
misi: To channel general assistance to asnaf children.
To offer practical and high-impact solutions.
To build a society that supports one another.

lembaga.title: BOARD OF TRUSTEES
lembaga.ahli1Quote: "Alhamdulillah, YIM remains committed to delivering high-impact programs to the entire asnaf community. We greatly appreciate the support of all parties."
lembaga.ahli2Quote: "I believe YIM is a fresh platform capable of leading the education sector, in line with the Ministry of Education's vision."

pendidikan.title: Education Program & Wakaf School Project by Yayasan Infaq Malaysia
pendidikan.desc: Education is the primary human capital in the initiative to build a developed nation. Yayasan Infaq Malaysia takes a proactive step in bringing world expertise to asnaf children in Malaysia. Integrated and comprehensive guidance is provided during and after school hours. This is crucial for us in building a solid character in preparation for the new generation to face a challenging and competitive world.

qurban.title: Aqiqah & Qurban by Yayasan Infaq Malaysia
items: Ready-cooked packages & distribution to Mosques @ Asnaf Children's Centre (PAKK)
Short visit packages to the country of slaughter
qurban.desc: Aqiqah and Qurban are deeply embedded in Malaysian society. Yayasan Infaq Malaysia (YIM) provides local aqiqah packages where distribution is made to the most deserving asnaf, namely asnaf children. YIM also provides international qurban/aqiqah packages for participants who wish to make a short visit to the respective country.

makanan.title: Hot Meal Distribution to Asnaf by Yayasan Infaq Malaysia
items: Food distribution for 30,000 asnaf children in the Klang Valley
5 types of Kaffarah & 7 types of Fidyah
Catering & wedding banquets with asnaf children
makanan.desc: Yayasan Infaq Malaysia also offers hot (ready-cooked) meal distribution to targeted asnaf children throughout Kuala Lumpur and Selangor. This program also accepts participation from individuals who wish to settle their Kaffarah and Fidyah debts and provide food to the poor and destitute asnaf.

kerjaKami.portfolioP1: Yayasan Infaq Malaysia (YIM) has been directly and indirectly involved in welfare programs locally and internationally for the past 12 years. These programs cover the welfare, education, and humanitarian mission sectors. The total accumulated experience of the board of trustees amounts to more than 50 years.
kerjaKami.portfolioP2: We invite more volunteers and donors to join hands in creating more integrated and beneficial programs for the community.
kerjaKami.portfolio2Desc: Aceh (2016), Zamboanga (2017), Nepal (2018), South Africa (2020), Tanzania (2019-2022).
kerjaKami.portfolio3Desc: Collaboration with the Selangor Islamic Religious Department, distributing 240kg of meat to 239 asnaf children.
